duration.title: Game duration
duration.description: Total playing time of the round. If the detectives fail to catch X within this time, X wins the game.

headStart.title: Head start
headStart.description: Time in minutes that X has alone before the game begins to build up distance. Detectives have to wait at the starting point in the meantime.
headStart.recommendation: Default: 0 min. (2–20 min. recommended for a large play area)

interval.title: Reveal interval
interval.description: Interval in minutes at which X's location is automatically revealed on the map for all detectives.
interval.recommendation: Default: 3 min. (shorter intervals make the hunt easier for detectives)

firstReveal.title: First location report
firstReveal.description: Time after the head start ends until X's location is reported for the first time.
firstReveal.recommendation: 0 min. = immediately after the head start; after that the configured interval applies.

revealRadius.title: Reveal radius
revealRadius.description: Blur of the reveal on the map. Detectives do not see an exact point but a circle with this radius in which X is located.
revealRadius.recommendation: Default: 5 m (practically an exact point; 50–100 m for more hide and seek)

catchRadius.title: Catch radius
catchRadius.description: Maximum GPS distance in meters between detective and X at which a catch attempt can succeed.
catchRadius.recommendation: Default: 30 m (compensates for normal smartphone GPS drift)

playArea.title: Play area (radius)
playArea.description: Radius of action around the shared starting point. If X leaves the area, the exact live location is transmitted as a penalty!

objective.title: Bonus mission for X
objective.description: During the round X picks a safe target in the play area. If X reaches it, the next reveal is postponed once by 2 minutes.
objective.recommendation: Optional: tactical extra goal for X
